children: Aptos Labs co-founder and CEO Avery Ching said on X that claims Aptos will shut down its blockchain within the next six months are a "stupid rumor." According to Odaily, public governance records show Aptos still has network upgrade proposals and completed mainnet feature updates, and no official plan to shut down the mainnet has been found.

title: Aptos Labs CEO Avery Ching Denies Rumors That Aptos Will Shut Down Within 6 Months
